look: a male goblin with olive-green skin, a big bald head, very large pointed ears, a long pointed nose and a small wiry body with thin sinewy arms
head_extras: Two tiny ivory fang points touch the outside of the dome's lower rim, set well apart. A very large pointed ear sticks out sideways from each side of the dome.
skin_words: muted olive-green hue, its lighter yellow-green highlights
line_words: heavy, crisp, near-black green contour line
face_tilt: a bony brow ridge whose overhang shades the eye sockets into two dark slits, right under it a long pointed nose that juts forward to a narrow tip, and just behind the nose the front of a narrow jaw with one tiny ivory fang rising from each corner of the lower lip. Brow, nose and fangs sit close together, squeezed by the steep view, and the nose tip and lower lip are the bottom edge of the head, with the chest starting directly below them. A very large pointed ear, a long leaf shape, sweeps out sideways and a little backward from each side of the head, lying over the shoulder.
torso_tilt: first the top plane of a narrow wiry chest with two small flat pectoral muscles meeting at the breastbone, then, tucked under the chest, a short glimpse of a small round belly.
face_paint: the head as a big bald scalp with, in the narrow strip along its bottom edge, a natural goblin face strongly foreshortened from above, a sly scowling brow over shadowed eye slits, a long pointed nose the same olive-green as the rest of the skin, and a narrow jaw with its two tiny fangs; each big ear a thin leaf of skin with a shallow inner hollow
torso_paint: the torso as one narrow wiry chest with two small flat pectoral muscles and a small round belly below them
